unit: Same species-region rows as original_regional_host_distance.parquet; no new outcome-based subset
background: Union of host plants in225-species catalogue excluding plants listed as hosts of the focal butterfly. This is a catalogue background, not confirmed biological non-hosts or complete regional flora.
features: Compare contemporary/native/contemporary-minus-native share for focal hosts against the corresponding share of background plant universe
matched_support: Within each feature and species require both host/background varying, outcome varying, >=5regions; repeat>=10regions. Use identical species and regions for paired correlations.
statistics: Species-equal mean host rho, background rho, paired difference(host minus background); species-bootstrap95% descriptive interval of paired difference when>=20species. Also partial Spearman by residualizing average ranks of host and distance against intercept plus background rank, retaining nonzero residual variance.
interpretation: Negative paired difference means matched host association is more negative than catalogue background. Does not prove resource mediation, causal host specificity, transport or forecast value; shared geography/phylogeny and present-day ranges remain unresolved. Background exclusions reflect catalogue knowledge, not feeding experiments.
